title: Concept: npm client prefers cached metadata over the registry
description: .npmrc declares a client setting that reuses cached package metadata instead of asking the registry, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Revoked or unpublished versions keep resolving from the cache, so a change made on the registry never reaches the build.
risk: Revoked or unpublished versions keep resolving from the cache, so a change made on the registry never reaches the build.
